notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/036b86c0185f1ef0cc5f5c5e57cf20d936dacb8d.jpg

🤗 Greetings, our dear players! We have big news for you 🤗

First of all, we want to say a huge thank you! Thank you to all those who have already bought our game and written funny reviews. You have bought 15,000 copies of the game so far, wow! We are very excited to have this kind of support on release, so you are all great guys 💚

That release was not without some sadness. Don't hurry to get upset, though! We are really sorry that the first impression of the game did not turn out to be pleasant for some people and they came across bugs. Now we are trying all days and nights to fix achievements, gallery and crashes, so soon everything will be fine 🥺

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/6a8e113f0df5dd9f365a5178a89a7f103fe4c388.jpg

Have a great day, our dear players!
Today is our SIGNIFICANT DAY! It's the first time you have a game branded by us - TopHouse Publishing on your screen! This news is so happy, so our friend's project - MILF's Plaza by Texic - will be the first one! The game is already released on Steam and is available in 13 languages 🧡 So let's go, let's go!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706300/MILFs_Plaza

MILF's Plaza is an erotic visual novel with a non-linear plot in a unique 2D style! The main character, full of ambition and eager for thrills, is ready to do anything to find his place in the sun. But his life is only turning out to be more complicated…

About the game:
 More than 50 animated NSFW scenes and erotic cards
 4 root girls and a some secondary ones too
 Open world and different mechanics (battles, mini-games)
 Opportunity to play in story or survival mode
 Languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish LatAm, Portuguese Br, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional (p.s. if your language shows Russian or English in the game, please let us know about the bugs, we will correct it as soon as possible)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/426d56c806015d4ce42d995daa950da5490367c6.jpg
★ Dynamic narrative ★
The plot is intended to enthrall and entertain. The dialogues are full of irony and references, and the scenes themselves are short and varied. All this is framed in a marvellous art style with plenty of emotional sprites, art inserts, animation and mini-games. An interactive novel in all its glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/a64189512d63e8679938e13e0acc79f55e0ddee9.jpg
★ Charming characters ★
The game is abundant with female characters, most of whom you can have a short or full-fledged romance with, drowning in the number of intimate scenes. Mary and Christy are the main characters, the completion of whose story not only doesn't end the game, but also unlocks new content: additional events, characters, quests and costumes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/043f0e80a6627afd1f9783c98dcef261e1eed2c1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/a241f4b984cfd4593f576e42d233eb44faa28964.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/c440516a9ba4999616947c2d580d8e81027fb29e.jpg
★ Sandbox ★
The gameplay has virtually no restrictions on your freedom of action and movement. With few exceptions, you are free to have affairs with whomever and whenever you want. For those who are particularly tempted by the genre, there is a "Survival" mode in the game, in which you need to sleep, eat and rest. And in general, it makes the gameplay more diverse and immerses you in the world of beautiful maidens.
